title: EL4CTEO/fast-anything
why_read: A pragmatic approach to performance optimization that automates profiling and selectively porting hot code paths to Rust with correctness verification.
analysis: This tool embodies a sensible optimization philosophy: instead of rewriting entire applications in a faster language, it profiles Python, Node, or Ruby code to find the actual bottlenecks and helps port just those hot functions to Rust. It leans on a coding agent to perform the translation and includes a way to verify the ported code behaves identically to the original, which is the hard part of such migrations. This is a genuinely useful and well-scoped idea for engineers facing performance problems in dynamic languages without wanting a full rewrite.
